characters.label: Recurring finance and economics presenter
characters.prompt: Original fictional Black male finance presenter in his thirties with warm brown skin, short sculpted loc twists and a clean taper, black rectangular glasses, a neatly trimmed goatee, tailored deep-indigo suit, pale blue shirt, copper tie, restrained gold circuit lapel pin, and brown cap-toe dress shoes with a subtle red-and-gold Spanish floral textile. Consistent adult proportions, friendly analytical expression, fully visible hands and feet. A light application of woodblock print and vox newspaper with rich anime colors.
characters.negative_prompt: No paper-craft, puppet or cut-out construction, no toy proportions, no photorealism, no celebrity likeness, no childish styling, no generated words, numbers, charts, logos, currency symbols, or watermarks.

characters.label: The same presenter as a stick figure - shorts, listicles, thumbnails
characters.prompt: A stick figure version of the original fictional Black male finance presenter: a large round head with a big wide face and big expressive eyes behind black rectangular glasses, a small neatly trimmed goatee, warm brown skin, and short sculpted loc twists on top of the head. The body is a thin single-line black stick figure with simple stick arms and legs and small round hands, wearing only a small flat deep-indigo suit block on the torso with a flat copper tie. Thick uniform black lines, solid flat colour fills, plain white ground, friendly analytical expression, legible when he fills five percent of a phone screen.
characters.negative_prompt: No realistic anatomy, no detailed tailoring, no lapel pin, no pocket square, no shoes with pattern, no paper or woodblock texture, no shading gradients, no photorealism, no celebrity likeness, no generated words, numbers, charts, logos, currency symbols, or watermarks.
